You should know it's this phone's final major update, with about 19 months of security patches left, and that US Razr+ 2024 owners are still waiting.

 Stable Android 17 has reached the European Motorola Razr 50 Ultra through Motorola's Software Fix PC tool, not yet over the air.
 The Razr 50 Ultra is the same phone sold in the US as the Razr+ 2024, where Android 17 hasn't been confirmed yet.
 Android 17 is the phone's third and final promised OS upgrade, with security patches running until about mid-2028.
 Owners should wait for the over-the-air update unless cover screen apps are broken for them on Android 16.
 Motorola Razr 50 Ultra owners in Europe can now install the stable Android 17 update, although for now it shows up in Motorola’s Software Fix PC tool rather than as an over-the-air download on the phone. The Razr 50 Ultra is sold in the US as the Razr+ 2024, and this update matters more than most because Motorola promised the phone only three Android version upgrades when it launched on Android 14 in 2024. Here’s how to get Android 17 now, what it changes, where US owners stand, and what the end of upgrades means if you own one or are thinking of buying one.

 The Motorola Razr 50 Ultra’s stable Android 17 build surfaced when an owner on r/razr ran Motorola’s Software Fix tool on a laptop and found it waiting for the European retail model, which means the update isn’t arriving over the air for most people yet. Software Fix, previously called Rescue and Smart Assistant, is a Windows app that can diagnose problems, manage data and reinstall device software on Motorola phones, according to Lenovo’s support page . 
 The tool identifies the right firmware from the phone’s IMEI, the unique number every phone carries, but its Rescue reinstall function wipes personal data, so a full backup has to come first. If you’d rather not plug the phone into a PC, the safer route is to keep checking Settings, then System updates , since Motorola usually ships big updates in batches that can take days or weeks to reach every phone. 
 What Android 17 Changes on the Motorola Razr 50 Ultra 
 The Motorola Razr 50 Ultra’s Android 17 build brings a redesigned Quick Settings panel, depth effects that let wallpaper subjects sit in front of the clock, a new clock style for the cover screen and, according to early owners, stronger vibration feedback. The fix owners care about most is on the cover screen, where apps ran poorly under Android 16 and early feedback says they behave properly again on Android 17. 
 It isn’t a clean release yet, though. One commenter in the Reddit thread says Android 17’s expanded app bubbles are missing, so only Messages conversations can float as bubbles, as before, and others report cover screen features that randomly stop working, with one calling the rollout “too early.” 
 Is the Motorola Razr 50 Ultra Sold in the US? 
 The Motorola Razr 50 Ultra isn’t sold in the US under that name, because it’s the same phone Motorola sells there as the Razr+ 2024, with the same Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chip and 4,000mAh battery. If you’re shopping in the US, the Razr+ 2024 listing is the version built for American carriers, and every Razr 50 Ultra software story applies to it too. 
 US owners are still waiting for stable Android 17, even though the Razr+ 2024 joined Motorola’s Android 17 beta in April alongside testers in India, Europe, Latin America and Brazil, and Motorola hasn’t confirmed a US date. The cheaper Razr 2024, called the Razr 50 outside the US, is in a worse spot, since it launched in 2024 with Android 14 and a promise of three OS upgrades yet doesn’t appear on Motorola’s published Android 17 eligibility list. 
 Android 17 Is the Motorola Razr 50 Ultra’s Final Major Update 
 The Motorola Razr 50 Ultra will not get Android 18, because Motorola promised it three Android version upgrades and four years of security patches at launch, and Android 15, 16 and 17 use up all three. Security patches arrive every other month, so with support running roughly four years from the phone’s mid-2024 launch, our arithmetic leaves about 19 months, or around nine more patches, after this update. 
 That timeline also shows how slowly the last upgrade arrived. Google released stable Android 17 on June 16, 2026, so the Razr 50 Ultra’s build turned up about five months later, after Motorola had already updated its 2025 and 2026 Razr models. Motorola’s newest flip phones still carry the same three-upgrade policy, which is why the Razr line keeps trailing rivals that promise seven years. 
 Razr 50 Ultra Owners Lose Little by Waiting for the Over-the-Air Update 
 Memeburn’s advice to Razr 50 Ultra owners is to wait for Android 17 to arrive over the air rather than forcing it through Software Fix, unless cover screen apps are broken enough under Android 16 to make the phone frustrating every day. There’s no Android 18 queued behind this release, so installing it early doesn’t move you closer to anything, and the early Reddit reports of missing bubbles and flaky cover screen features suggest a follow-up patch is likely, while the Rescue route carries a real risk of wiping the phone. Our view changes if the over-the-air rollout still hasn’t reached your region by the end of January 2027, since by then the cover screen fix is worth the backup-and-reinstall effort. 
 For buyers, the same numbers point the other way. A Razr 50 Ultra or Razr+ 2024 bought now comes with no more Android upgrades and roughly 19 months of security patches, so it only makes sense at a deep discount, and our guide to the best foldable phone options shows newer flips that start their software clock from 2026 instead. 
 FAQs 
 Is the Motorola Razr 50 Ultra the same as the Razr+ 2024? 
 Yes. The Motorola Razr 50 Ultra is the international name for the phone Motorola sells in the US as the Razr+ 2024. Both use the Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chip and the same hardware. 
 Will the Motorola Razr 50 Ultra get Android 18? 
 No. Motorola promised the Razr 50 Ultra three Android version upgrades when it launched on Android 14 in 2024, so Android 17 is its final major update. Security patches continue for about four years from launch. 
 Does Motorola Software Fix erase your data? 
 It can. Software Fix’s Rescue function reinstalls the phone’s software and erases personal data, so back up your phone before using it to install an update. 
 Is the Razr 2024 getting Android 17? 
 Not according to Motorola’s published Android 17 list. The Razr 2024, sold internationally as the Razr 50, isn’t on the list, even though it launched with a promise of three Android upgrades.
